## Connection interface

A live handle to the configured database.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Connection 
```

## Remarks

Bindings are always written as `?` placeholders regardless of dialect; each driver rewrites them to its own placeholder syntax before executing. That keeps migrations, seeders and the schema builder free of dialect branches.

Obtain one from [createConnection()](./database.createconnection.md)<!-- -->, and always [Connection.close()](./database.connection.close.md) it when the process is done — the Postgres and MySQL drivers hold a pool open otherwise.
